title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing the coaching standards and development of badminton talent across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced an advanced Level-1 coaches course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Unnati Hooda, Arjun-Hariharan Begin China Masters Challenge
indian_angle: Indian shuttlers Unnati Hooda, MR Arjun, and Hariharan Amsakarun are set to compete on the opening day of the China Masters, representing India's hopes in the international tournament.
summary: Day 1 of the China Masters 2026 in Shenzhen will see Indian players Unnati Hooda in women's singles and the men's doubles pair of MR Arjun and Hariharan Amsakarun in action.

title: Lakshya Sen Leads India's Charge at China Masters
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler Lakshya Sen is expected to lead the Indian contingent, with significant attention also on the performance of young Indian women's singles players.
summary: Lakshya Sen is set to spearhead the Indian challenge at the China Masters, where a promising trio of young women's singles players will also be under the spotlight.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships
indian_angle: These regulations are vital for the smooth conduct and competitive integrity of one of India's premier domestic team badminton events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating states.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Held in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is a critical preparatory phase for India's promising young shuttlers before they represent the nation at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 and U15 junior badminton teams was held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing them for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior badminton is played and developed across India in the U13, U15, and U17 age categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
